content.title: Upgrades #3
content.body:
Prepare to fight the Wither:
    §lWeapons:
    - Vulcanite ranged/melee weapons
    - Equipment Forge: Used to make tools and weapons with monster parts.
    - Tome of Arcana (Apprentice): Upgrades your wand to allow Apprentice spells to be used (Tip: Astral Diamonds are found in Vanilla or Ocean structures).
    - Apprentice Spells
    §lMisc:
    - Middle Backpack
